data.one_liner: Create animated, customizable snackbars with message types, durations, positions, and text-to-speech.
data.what_it_does: Snackify is a Flutter package that lets developers display customizable, animated snackbars. It supports different snack types (success, error, warning, info), custom gradients, positions, persistent display options, and built-in Text-to-Speech integration.
use_when: You need styled snackbars with success, error, warning, or info variants.
You want built-in text-to-speech accessibility for app notifications.
You need snackbars positioned at the top or bottom with custom animation and duration settings.
avoid_when: You need persistent background push or local system tray notifications.
You prefer fully declarative UI-based overlay management without imperative static method calls.
strengths: Pre-styled snackbar types (success, error, warning, info).
Supports custom gradients, shadows, positions, and persistent states.
weaknesses: Relies on imperative static show methods rather than declarative widget trees.
Limited to snackbar and alert notifications.

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want highly customizable and modern toast notifications with a rich set of built-in styles and animations.

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you just need simple, lightweight native-feeling toast messages across platforms.

alternatives.name: another_flushbar
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want feature-rich flushbars with custom buttons, indicators, and animations.

data.minimal_example:
Snackify.show(
  context: context,
  type: SnackType.success,
  title: Text('Hello !'),
  subtitle: Text('This is a custom Snackbar.'),
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 3),
);
